key_insight: GraphMuon adapts matrix-aware optimization to graph-propagated feature geometry, mitigating update amplification that vanilla Muon can encounter in GNNs.
engineering_relevance: GraphMuon can reduce GNN training time to a target validation loss while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance in the reported evaluations.
method: Model layer-input geometry using the covariance of graph-propagated representations.
Orthogonalize matrix updates in this graph-aware metric.
Normalize step sizes by the update’s induced effect on layer representations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 1.32×–2.42× validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks and lower time-to-target in 13 of 15 dataset–architecture configurations.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify the overhead of covariance-aware updates, so assess memory and runtime costs on your target graphs and architectures.
paper_title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
